heroText: Stavanger works best as a base in Norway when you anchor days around Gamle Stavanger, Norwegian Petroleum Museum and Lysefjord. Use those sights to understand the city's history, street life and visitor rhythm. Stavanger Sola handles the main arrival flow, so hotel choice should balance the centre, transfer time and day-trip plans.

history.label: 1120s
history.text: Stavanger fulfilled an urban role prior to its status as city (1125), from around the time the Stavanger bishopric was established in the 1120s.

Archaeological investigations in the current downtown and in the crypt of Stavanger Cathedral show that the great fire of 1272 probably left large parts of the city and the cathedral in ruins, including the Romanesque chancel of the cathedral.
Kongsberg was plundered by Christoffer Trondsen in 1539, at which time St. Swithun's casket disappeared and Bishop Hoskuld Hoskuldsson may have been executed.
The airport had been built in 1937, and in April 1940 fortifications round the airport were not yet complete.
The bomber wing was transferred to Sola Airport in 1939, but the planes, a total of six Fokker and three Caproni aircraft, were old and outdated.
Finally on 1 July 1953, a final portion of Hetland Municipality (population: 831) was moved to Stavanger.
